headerText.description: Extracts the general header information, such as the government name, office name, zone, corporation, and document title.

logoText.description: Extracts any text specifically associated with logos on the document.

birthRegistrationNumber.description: The unique birth registration number assigned to the certificate.

dateOfRegistration.description: The date when the birth was registered.

dateOfIssuance.description: The date when the certificate was issued.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the registered individual.

name.description: Full name of the person whose birth is registered.

mother.description: Information about the mother of the registered individual.

father.description: Information about the father of the registered individual.

placeOfBirth.description: Location where the birth occurred, typically city/district and country.

permanentAddress.description: The permanent residential address of the registered individual or family, including ward, zone, and area details.
